personality.title: Personality test
personality.heading: How do you work in a team?
personality.lead: {{count}} statements, about 3 minutes. Describe yourself as you generally are now, not as you wish to be in the future. Describe yourself as you honestly see yourself, in relation to other people you know of the same sex as you are, and roughly your same age. There are no right answers: be honest, it helps us build groups where everyone has a role.
personality.yearly: You need to complete this test once per academic year to use StudyMatch. Your answers can't be changed after you submit them.
personality.privacy: Your profile is used to balance groups this academic year. Only you, your teachers and staff can see it.

questions.1: I am the life of the party.
questions.3: I get chores done right away.
questions.7: I am not interested in other people's problems.
questions.8: I often forget to put things back in their proper place.
questions.9: I am relaxed most of the time.
questions.10: I am not interested in abstract ideas.
questions.11: I talk to a lot of different people at parties.
questions.15: I have difficulty understanding abstract ideas.
questions.17: I am not really interested in others.
questions.18: I make a mess of things.
questions.20: I do not have a good imagination.
